breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt provided two contradictory boundary conditions: 'Simply-supported' (u=0 and Δu=0) and 'Neumann (zero-flux)' (∂u/∂n = 0). The ground truth correctly removed the extraneous Neumann condition. The generated specification also correctly removed the Neumann condition and only included the simply-supported conditions, stating 'Impose simply‑supported Dirichlet boundary conditions: u=0 and Δu=0 on all edges'.
